$comment: NO $schema KEY, and its absence is deliberate rather than an omission. The
edit that brought this file's server list in also carried
`https://json.schemastore.org/mcp.json`, which redirects to a 404 -- the IDE
said so as soon as it was saved, and SchemaStore's catalogue has no entry for
Claude Code's .mcp.json at all. A $schema pointing at nothing is a claim that
this file is validated when nothing validates it, which is the shape this
repository calls a named control that is not a control. Removed rather than
swapped for a URL that merely resolves.
Project-scoped MCP servers. THIS FILE IS COMMITTED, so every entry runs on
every teammate's machine the first time they open the project -- and each one
is `npx -y`, which installs and executes a package from the registry without
asking. That is the reason the list is short and every entry earns its place.
NOTHING IN `pnpm verify` DEPENDS ON ANY OF THEM. A gate that needed an MCP
server running would be a gate that cannot run in CI. These are authoring
aids; the gate reads the repository.
context7        library documentation, fetched at the version in use rather
than recalled. Earned its place already: base-ui's own page
is what caught an <Autocomplete.Status /> with no children
sitting under a comment claiming it announced a result count.
nextjs          next-devtools-mcp -- runtime errors, route and build state
from the dev server. REPLACES the http entry that used to be
here pointing at localhost:3000/_next/mcp; that one only
existed while `next dev` was running and answered nothing
otherwise.
shadcn          the official shadcn CLI's MCP mode, for its component
registry. PRIOR ART ONLY, and the distinction is enforced
rather than trusted: shadcn is Radix + Tailwind + className
variants, and three rules here refuse that stack -- law 30
on a second primitive library beside Base UI,
`09-xforge.md` on Tailwind, and the `no-bespoke-styling`
guard on className. Read it for anatomy and API shape; never
run `shadcn add` in this repository. Recorded as E24 in the
evidence register.
shadcn-studio   third-party, and the only entry here that is not published
by the tool it serves. It needs SHADCN_STUDIO_API_KEY and
SHADCN_STUDIO_EMAIL in the environment; both are personal
credentials and neither belongs in .env.example, which is
the APPLICATION's configuration.
WHY THERE IS NO POSTGRES ENTRY, and it is not an oversight -- see $disabled
below, which keeps the exact configuration so re-enabling is a copy rather
than a rewrite.

the package is DEPRECATED   `npm view @modelcontextprotocol/server-postgres
deprecated` returns 'Package no longer
supported.' It is one of the reference servers
the MCP organisation retired.
the credentials do not      AFENDA_DB_READONLY_PASSWORD, AFENDA_DB_HOST,
exist                       AFENDA_DB_PORT and AFENDA_DB_NAME are all
unset here, and none is declared anywhere in
the repository -- not in .env.example, not in

interpolate to literal '${...}' text.
Enabled, it would fail to connect on every session start and print a banner
saying so -- which is exactly what the Neon server already does in this
workspace. A server that cannot start is not a capability; it is a warning
people learn to scroll past, and this repository has a whole section on what
that costs.

through `tests/fixtures/local-database`, so check whether an MCP server is
the thing that was actually wanted before adding a dependency for it.
